interpretation: Conjecture 5 uses the local-density coordinate α/L to transfer the matrix crossover F_k(2πα) into a discrete shifted-zeta moment while retaining separate arithmetic and Barnes-G factors. This one proposed law links two distinct limits: α→0, provided the stated uniformity really licenses interchange with T→∞, yields derivative moments at zeros; taking α=Lβ as the zero density grows is meant to erase local zero conditioning and recover ordinary-moment scaling in a discrete mean. The latter passage is not justified over the full stated range β>0 by the displayed uniformity alone: |α|≤L covers α=Lβ directly only for 0<β≤1, so β>1 requires a wider uniformity statement or another argument.
